records.source: Which phases a run without its own phase list runs, in the order spaCR runs them, as 'stitch,phenotype,objects,decode,ph_segment,ph_measure,ph_masks,merge,aggregate'. With it, spacr-run ops runs the phenotype, merge and aggregate phases from the settings file alone, so the file reproduces the run. A phase spaCR does not know is refused before anything runs. Empty runs stitch, phenotype, objects and decode, as before. Default None. Alpha.
records.translation: Vilka faser en körning utan egen faslista kör, i den ordning spaCR kör dem, till exempel 'stitch,phenotype,objects,decode,ph_segment,ph_measure,ph_masks,merge,aggregate'. Med den kör spacr-run ops faserna phenotype, merge och aggregate enbart från inställningsfilen, så att filen återskapar körningen. En fas som spaCR inte känner till avvisas innan något körs. Tomt kör stitch, phenotype, objects och decode, som tidigare. Standard None. Alfa.
